editorial:
Imagine waking up every single morning with the same scary dream, but you can't quite remember why it's happening. That is exactly where you find yourself with the main character, a college student who feels like something is missing from her childhood. As she digs deeper, you realize she isn't just dealing with bad dreams, but suppressed memories of something truly awful. The vibe is very tense and mysterious, making you feel the same confusion and fear that she does as she tries to piece together her broken past. It is a slow-burn mystery that keeps you guessing about what actually happened years ago.

What really works here is the acting, as you can feel the raw emotion in every scene. The twists are surprising and keep the plot moving, although some parts feel a bit slow. If you enjoy stories about uncovering secrets and solving crimes, you will love this one.
endingExplained: You find out that the main character was actually kidnapped as a child by a man who kept her in a hidden room. The nightmare she had was a memory of her escape and the violence involved. In the end, she faces her captor one last time to get closure. She manages to survive the encounter and finally finds peace knowing the killer is stopped and her past is finally clear.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological mysteries and stories about overcoming trauma.
